sources.location: HTTP Range captures of the six ZIP central directories in scratchpad/PXD056651/*.d.zip.tail
https://www.cellosaurus.org/CVCL_0045; HEK293 identity confirmed by local sdrf-tools cellline lookup

claims.value: three Bruker .d vendor directories from ribo ZIP archives
claims.evidence: PRIDE lists six .d.zip raw archives; each ZIP central directory contains a .d directory identical to its archive stem. MQ_output.zip is search output and excluded.

claims.location: source name and characteristics[biological replicate] rows 1-3
claims.value: three distinct run-level source IDs; biological replicate 1 within each source
claims.evidence: The cyto1-3 and ribo1-3 suffixes identify six runs. The deposit does not resolve whether within-group runs are independent biological preparations or technical injections, so their source IDs remain distinct and no cross-run replicate relationship is asserted.
PRIDE organism CV lists human; protocol describes HEK293 ribosomes and HeLa or HEK293 cytoplasm.

claims.location: characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[cellosaurus name] rows 1-3
claims.evidence: The ribosome isolation paragraph explicitly names HEK293; cytoplasm isolation says 'HeLa or HEK293' without assigning either to cyto1-3. The raw names provide no line identity.
The protocol separately describes purified ribosomes and ribosome-depleted cytoplasmic lysate; the filenames explicitly end cyto1-3 or ribo1-3.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[ms1 scan range], comment[ms2 scan range]
claims.value: timsTOF Pro 2; DDA-PASEF; 100-1700 m/z for both MS and MS/MS
claims.evidence: PRIDE instrument CV gives timsTOF Pro 2 MS:1003230. Protocol specifies DDA-PASEF and both MS and MS/MS scan range 100-1700 m/z. The SDRF acquisition term is the generic DDA controlled term.

In the protocol's Sample prep paragraph: 'For purified ribosomes and cytoplasmic lysates, 1 ug Trypsin was added, and samples incubated over night at 37 °C.' This is digestion, distinct from trypsinization of cells in the cytoplasm isolation paragraph.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0045 identifies HEK293 as a human embryonic kidney-derived cell line; this records the line origin, not a tissue biopsy.

limitations: The ribosome preparation is explicitly HEK293; the related cytosol runs are in a separate SDRF because their cell line is unresolved.
Run suffixes do not establish biological versus technical replication; no relationship among the three runs per fraction is asserted.
The organ part, disease, donor age, sex, individual, dissociation method, mass tolerances, and modification parameters are not assigned from this record.
The automated PRIDE reconciler flags trypsin as unsupported, but the protocol's Sample prep paragraph explicitly identifies it as the digest enzyme.
